name: io.github.Servosity/cork-mcp
title: Cork MCP
description: Every Cork API operation, plus cross-client risk attribution and exploitability-first vuln triage.

environmentVariables.name: CORK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the CORK_API_KEY credential for the Cork MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: CORK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Cork API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: CORK_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Cork requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
